latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "humanize-ai-writing" skill.

- Automatically rewrites AI-generated developer docs to remove robotic tone, inflated language, filler, and tautologies.
- Integrates with output from "review-ai-writing" to identify and correct problematic writing patterns.
- Offers safe/risky fix classification with auto-apply for safe fixes and interactive prompts for riskier changes.
- Supports filtering fixes by category and dry run mode for previewing changes.
- Performs safety checks, validation, and reports a concise summary of applied and skipped changes.
